call.x: Apply for funding to increase our understanding of novel ecosystems, their socio-ecological dynamics and consequences, and future pathways and trajectories of change. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for funding.
n: Run by Natural Environment Research Council (NERC). The organiser sets the rules; Eligible Calls reads this call from UKRI Funding Finder (ukri.org).

UKRI-biodiversa-2026-to-2027-novel-ecosy.heading: How we will assess your application

blocks.text: You should refer to the Biodiversa+ website for full details on how your application will be assessed.
The assessment process will be led by the Biodiversa+. Your application will be assessed by independent experts in a two- stage process:
at step 1 (pre-proposal stage): fit to the scope of the opportunity, novelty of the research and impact

at step 2 (full proposal stage): scientific excellence, quality and efficiency of the implementation of the project plan, and impact (including expected societal impact which includes policy impact, and approach to stakeholder engagement).

consortium.quote: Unless otherwise provided for in the specific call/topic conditions, only legal entities forming a consortium are eligible to participate in actions provided that the consortium includes, as beneficiaries, three legal entities independent from each other and each established in a different country as follows: – at least one independent legal entity established in a Member State; and – at least two other independent legal entities, each established in different Member States or Associated Countries.
